title: [Main]- Item Journal approval link fails after approver switches batches
summary: Fixed item journal approval links failing when approvers had previously accessed a different batch. The IsOpenedFromBatch method now correctly uses the record's template and batch instead of falling back to the user's saved batch.
key_points: Item Journal's IsOpenedFromBatch now matches General Journal's implementation
When no batch filter is set, the method uses the record's own batch name
Special filter characters in batch names are properly quoted
Approval email links now navigate to the correct batch for the approver
Applied to W1 and all localized versions (APAC, CH, ES, FR, GB, IT, RU)
